description: This file defines a RuntimeCache class that manages caching of runtime states associated with actor keys. It includes types for cached runtime states, snapshots, and cache entries, as well as methods for cache manipulation such as get, set, clear, and snapshot generation.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A class that manages a cache of runtime states mapped by actor keys, with capabilities to retrieve, set, delete, and snapshot cache entries, as well as collect idle candidates based on inactivity duration.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a cache entry exists for a given actor key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the cached runtime state for a given actor key; optionally updates the last touched timestamp.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the cached runtime state for an actor key without updating its last touched timestamp.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the last touched timestamp for a given actor key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates the cache entry for a given actor key with a runtime state, updating the last touched timestamp.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the cache entry for a specific actor key.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Generates an array of cache snapshots, optionally at a specified timestamp.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Returns cache entries that have been idle longer than a specified maximum idle duration.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
